# 1d: Qobuz module

## Read first

- [sources/qobuz.md](../sources/qobuz.md), [architecture.md](../architecture.md) section Source interfaces, [provenance.md](../provenance.md).
- The As built sections of [1b](1b.md) and [1c](1c.md); qobuz-dl-go's `README.md`, `UPSTREAM.md`, `qobuzdltest`, and the sections Public API, Settings and options, Progress and Result, and downloadsdb of its `docs/design.md`.

## Done when

- `internal/modules/qobuz` implements `Source`, `LinkParser`, `Searcher`, `Resolver` and `Downloader` over qobuz-dl-go `v0.1.0` or later.
- The module is enabled in `main` when `SHELF_QOBUZ_TOKEN` is set.
- shelf's `DownloadsDB` adapter over `downloaded_items` is in use.
- `shelf manage import-qobuz-db <path>` works.
- Every checklist line has its test, against `qobuzdltest`.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Startup | `New`, `GetTokens` and `InitializeClient` in the background after start; until then health says "starting". A failure retries every 5 minutes. | shelf starts even when Qobuz is unreachable. |
| HTTP client | One `*http.Client` without `Timeout`, passed as `Options.HTTPClient`, for API calls and transfers alike. qobuz-dl-go's `DefaultOptions` timeouts apply per call. With `SHELF_QOBUZ_USE_PROXY`, the client goes through `SHELF_PROXY_URL`. | A client `Timeout` would cut long transfers; per-module proxy choice. |
| Links | `ParseLink` calls `GetURLInfo` on the whole URL and maps `/interpreter/` to an artist. | sources/qobuz.md. |
| Search | `Search` maps qobuz-dl-go's search results to `source.Item` with the quality badge rules from sources/qobuz.md. Fewer than 3 characters answers an empty page. | qobuz-dl's rule. |
| Resolve | Albums and playlists come with tracks. Artists and labels come with their albums in one section, sorted by release date, newest first. | The UI panels and the expansion step. |
| Download | Album and track call `DownloadFromID`; playlist calls `HandleID` with the kind `playlist`, which writes the m3u8. Options start from `DefaultOptions()` with the settings from sources/qobuz.md. Progress maps onto `Reporter`, and the `*Result` gives the folders, files and delivered formats. `DownloadResult.Tool` is `qobuz-dl-go <version> porting qobuz-dl <version>`. | Parity with the old bot. |
| Provenance fields | Label, release date, UPC, and per track the Qobuz track ID and ISRC. | provenance.md. |
| Import | Paths outside the music root are kept as they are and logged. `kind` other than `album` and `track` is skipped and counted. | Old rows can point anywhere. |

## Files

```
internal/modules/qobuz/qobuz.go, links.go, search.go, resolve.go, download.go, downloadsdb.go, health.go
internal/modules/qobuz/*_test.go
cmd/shelf/main.go                       enable the module
cmd/shelf/manage_import.go              import-qobuz-db
```

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| Every link form from sources/qobuz.md, including `/interpreter/` | `TestParseLinkForms` |
| A link from another site is not claimed | `TestParseLinkOtherSites` |
| Search maps each type and the quality badges | `TestSearchMapsTypes`, `TestQualityBadges` |
| A query under 3 characters gives an empty page | `TestSearchShortQuery` |
| An album resolves with its tracks; an artist and a label with their albums | `TestResolveKinds` |
| An artist or label without albums, `ErrEmptyContent` from qobuz-dl-go, resolves to an empty section | `TestResolveEmptyCollection` |
| `Formats` lists Max, 24/96, CD and MP3 320, Max first | `TestFormats` |
| A download reports planned tracks, progress and files | `TestDownloadReports` |
| A playlist goes through `HandleID` and its folder gets the m3u8 | `TestPlaylistDownloadWritesM3U8` |
| The module's HTTP client has no `Timeout` | `TestHTTPClientHasNoTimeout` |
| `DownloadResult` carries folders, files and the tool line | `TestDownloadResult` |
| A 401 marks the source unhealthy with "token expired" | `TestHealthTokenExpired` |
| The proxy setting routes the module's requests | `TestProxyOptIn` |
| The `DownloadsDB` adapter answers from `downloaded_items` | `TestDownloadsDBAdapter` |
| The import maps rows, makes paths relative, skips other kinds | `TestImportMapsRows` |
| A second import changes nothing | `TestImportIsIdempotent` |

## As built

Finished on 2026-11-04. `make check`, `make lint`, `make web-check` and `docker build .` pass. Every test in the checklist exists under the name given there and passes against `qobuzdltest`. Reversing each of 19 decisions in the code failed at least one test. A manual run of the binary with no token refused a link by name, imported a `qobuz_dl.db` that Python's sqlite3 wrote, and skipped the imported album. A run with a made-up token read the live web player's bundle and got Qobuz's real 401: health said `token expired`, search answered 503 with `Qobuz: token expired`, and the token stayed out of the log. A later run used a real token; see "First run with a real token" below. Checks 3 to 8 of [manual-checklist.md](../manual-checklist.md) repeat it on blackberry in 1h.

What differs from the contract:

- `main` always lists the module, and the source registers switched off without `SHELF_QOBUZ_TOKEN`, as 1b's notes ask. A link then gets "Qobuz is not set up in Shelf".
- One qobuz-dl-go instance per format, and one per format without a database for forced downloads. Only the default format's instance exists after the start, and the others log in on first use.
- Album and track downloads pass `IgnoreDB`, so only a playlist's tracks reach `Has`. `Has` ignores the quality. The reasons are in [decisions.md](../decisions.md).
- The import maps `/downloads/<folder>` to `<SHELF_QOBUZ_DIR>/<folder>`, because that is what the old rows say. The highest quality wins between rows of one item.
- `ParseLink` also reads `/playlists/` and `/label/<slug>/download-streaming-albums/<id>`.
- Calls wait up to a minute for the first login attempt.
- `internal/source` gained `Unavailable`, and `catalog` answers it with 503 and its reason. `fakesource.Source` gained `Fail`, which tests set.
- `downloads.Service` gained `IsDownloaded`, `RecordDownloaded` and `ImportDownloaded` in `history.go`, as 1b's notes ask. The module's `History` port takes the first two.
- The import's reading and mapping are in `internal/modules/qobuz/import.go`, and `cmd/shelf/manage_import.go` only prints the counts.
- `Reporter.Done` goes out twice for a track with a file, because `TrackEnd` has the path in the work folder.
- `DownloadResult.Files` lists the audio files and the m3u8, as Apple Music's lists its songs. Covers, booklets and tracklists aren't in it. Nothing reads `Files` yet.
- A playlist's cover comes from `images300` in `Playlist.Raw`, because the view's `Images` are 50 pixels wide.
- A track's plan takes its artist from the album, since `ReleaseInfo` has no track. A single track of a compilation shows the album artist while it downloads, and `download_tracks` keeps that.
- An artist or label without albums has no title, because `ErrEmptyContent` drops the answer that named it. The bot falls back on the link.
- `go get` raised `modernc.org/sqlite` to `v1.61.1`, which qobuz-dl-go requires.
- More tests than the checklist lists: runs through the real download job in `job_test.go`, two queued copies of one album, a resumed playlist, a call waiting for the start, a failed start that retries, a read-only import, and tokens staying out of the logs.

Known limit: a playlist resumed after a restart reports the tracks of the first run as `skipped`, without a file name or format in `shelf.txt`, because they are on record by then. Their files stay in the folder, and the m3u8 lists them.

### First run with a real token

Run on 2026-11-04 with `serve` on the owner's Mac, a Studio account, scratch data and music folders, and Apple Music and Navidrome off. All calls went through the API, since the UI doesn't exist yet. To repeat it, set `SHELF_QOBUZ_TOKEN`, `SHELF_DATA_DIR` and `SHELF_MUSIC_DIR`, set `SHELF_AMDL_CONFIG` and `SHELF_NAVIDROME_URL` to empty, and start `serve`. `qobuz-dl dl -q 27 -d DIR -db FILE URL` from qobuz-dl-go gives the files to compare against, with `QOBUZ_TOKEN` set.

| What | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Login and health | Health said `ok` with the label Studio, a few seconds after the login line. |
| Search and lookups | Search answered for albums, tracks, artists and playlists. Albums, tracks, playlists, artists and labels resolved, from 11 link forms. |
| Files against `qobuz-dl -q 27` | In Rainbows, Kid A, Pablo Honey, The Bends and OK Computer OKNOTOK match byte for byte, 78 files in all, apart from `shelf.txt`. |
| Cancel and retry | Kid A went to `[INCOMPLETE]`, and a retry fetched the 8 tracks left and removed the marker. |
| Stop during a download | Pablo Honey stopped within 2 seconds, went to `[INCOMPLETE]` and resumed after the restart. |
| `kill -9` during a download | The Bends stayed `[IN PROGRESS]` and resumed after the restart. |
| Skip and force | A second request gave `skipped`. Force fetched a track deleted from the folder, and the new file matches the reference. |
| Import | A `qobuz_dl.db` from the CLI added 5 rows, a second import added none, and imported albums gave `skipped`. |
| Other kinds | An MP3 track, a 39-track playlist with an m3u8 that lists every file, and a label with one album of 29 tracks all finished without a failed track. |
| Files | All 137 audio files decode in full with ffmpeg. New folders are 0755 and new files 0644. `shelf.txt` is right, and a second download appends a block. |
| Secrets | The token is in no log, database, text file or API answer. |

During OKNOTOK, Qobuz's CDN cut transfers four times and the downloader switched to segmented download. The album still matches the reference, so that path works against the real CDN.

The playlist and the label's album weren't compared with `qobuz-dl`. Ownership by UID 10001 and a playlist resumed after a restart weren't tried.

The run left four open issues, listed in the notes of [status.md](../status.md): force on a complete folder, the failed count of a canceled download, the empty title of an imported album, and the order of ID3 frames in MP3 files.

### Notes for later steps

- 1g: the Status page reads `Detail` of the Qobuz source as `{label, proxy}`. `source` events carry `id`, `ok` and `message`. A search can answer 503 with a reason to show, such as `Qobuz: token expired`.
- 1h: step 5 of the cutover prints what the import did. Rows with a path outside the music folder are logged one by one, and they don't stop the import.
